newsitem.title: GREECE: FINDINGS ON BROKERS' AUDITS HANDED TO MINISTRY WEDS.
newsitem.headline: FINDINGS ON BROKERS' AUDITS HANDED TO MINISTRY WEDS.

text.p: The findings of auditors KPMG, Deloitte & Touche and Ernst & Young who audited the books of the Athens bourse's 65 member brokerages will be handed to national economy ministry on Wednesday, ministry officials said.
The three firms were retained by the national economy ministry to audit brokers after the Delta Securities scandal late last year.
The findings will be handed to National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou, general secretary Apostolos Fotiadis and capital markets commission president Stavros Thomadakis.
Thomadakis returns to work on Wednesday from the U.S. where he spent the Christmas holidays. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
